question_en: What is the capital city of Somalia?
Which ancient trading empire was located on the Somali coast and traded with ancient Egypt?
question_so: Kuwama ahaa boqortooyadii qadiimiga ahayd ee ka jirtay xeebaha Soomaalida ee xiriirka la lahayd dalka Masar?

question_en: Which animal holds central economic, cultural, and spiritual value in Somali nomadic life?
question_so: Xayawaankee buu yahay kan ugu muhiimsan dhaqaalaha, dhaqanka, iyo nolosha reer miyiga Soomaalida?

question_en: What is the highest mountain peak in Somalia, located in the Cal Madow range of Sanaag?
question_so: Waa maxay buurta ugu dheer Soomaaliya ee ku taal silsiladda Cal Madow ee Sanaag?

question_en: Who led the historic 20-year Darwiish armed resistance movement against colonial forces?
question_so: Yaa hoggaaminayay dhaqdhaqaaqii halganka hubaysnaa ee 20-ka sano ee Darwiishta ee la dagaallamay gumeystaha?

question_en: Which major river flows directly through the cities of Jowhar and Beledweyne in southern Somalia?
question_so: Wabigee weeye kan mara magaalooyinka Jowhar iyo Beledweyne ee koonfurta Soomaaliya?

question_en: What is the famous traditional Somali oral poetry form that is traditionally sung or chanted by men?
question_so: Waa maxay qaabka ugu caansan maansada Soomaalida ee raggu tiriyan ama ku luuqeeyaan?

question_en: In which historic year did the northern and southern Somali territories gain independence and unify?
question_so: Sannadkee bay gobollada waqooyi iyo koonfur ee Soomaaliya xornimadooda qaateen isla markaana midoobeen?

question_en: Which geographic zone represents the dry and hot coastal plain between the Gulf of Aden and the Goolis mountains?
question_so: Aaggee juqraafi ahaan u taagan dhuldeexda kulul ee u dhaxaysa Gacanka Cadmeed iyo buuraha Goolis?

question_en: Who designed the light-blue Somali national flag with the five-pointed white star in 1954?
question_so: Yaa naqshadeeyay calanka buluugga ah ee leh xiddigta shanta gees leh ee Soomaaliya sannadkii 1954-kii?
